name: SunRay Charleston 400TN | 4-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Charleston 4-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna is designed to bring family and friends together for a classic sauna experience at home. Built from natural Canadian hemlock wood, it features a 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater capable of reaching up to 170°F. The 2-tiered double bench seating provides ample room for 4 people to sit comfortably or 2 people to recline. A water cask and spoon allow for steam generation, while a thermo-hygrometer displays humidity levels. Standard features include interior dome lighting, a ventilation system, ergonomic backrests, and tempered glass details for durability and style.
